title: Spec 014 Durable Tenant Authority Row Ambiguity

phases.objective: Prove exact cardinality before reading the current durable Tenant authority row and fail closed when one authority identity resolves to multiple rows.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The public durable Tenant authority read methods backed by loadCurrent
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Zero rows return null, one row is parsed, and multiple allowlist or approval rows return STORAGE_DURABLE_AUTHORITY_ROW_AMBIGUOUS without selecting a first candidate.
steps: Create the unmounted durable Tenant authority store with exact signed-schema contract evidence.
Inject two durable rows for one allowlist identity and call readAllowlist.
Require a fail-closed HTTP 409 ambiguity result with bounded authority type and ID details.
Inject two durable rows for one approval identity and call readApproval.
Require the same fail-closed ambiguity result and prove every database connection is released.
Run the complete durable authority store regression suite to preserve registration, replay, CAS, immutable token history, rollback, and export behavior.
assertions: The runtime does not use rows[0] or any equivalent first-candidate selection after cardinality validation.
More than one row fails with STORAGE_DURABLE_AUTHORITY_ROW_AMBIGUOUS and status 409.
The error identifies only authority_type and authority_id and contains no secret or raw record payload.
The existing durable authority store regression remains green.
The store remains unmounted and performs no migration apply, provider dispatch, Hostinger access, deployment, main merge, or Production mutation.

phases.objective: Promote and apply the durable authority schema only through a separately authorized migration cycle and prove live unique-key parity before runtime mount.
blockers: No signed live unique-key and cardinality readback exists.
The async durable authority store remains unmounted.

phases.objective: Exercise cardinality corruption during concurrent reads and same-transaction lock acquisition while preserving bounded ambiguity evidence.
This synthetic persistence regression performs no live database or Tenant canary.
This change grants no migration, deployment, provider, or Production authority.
